description: A React component for selecting and managing team memberships in Mattermost, including fetching team data, handling user interactions, and rendering UI elements for team selection, creation, and system management links.

classes.name: SelectTeam
classes.description: A React component for selecting and managing user team memberships, including fetching team data, handling user actions, and rendering the UI for team selection and creation.

methods.name: fetchMoreTeams
methods.description: Fetches additional team data from the server and updates the component state.

methods.name: handleTeamClick
methods.description: Handles user clicking on a team to join, including API call and error handling.

methods.name: handleLogoutClick
methods.description: Logs out the current user and redirects to login.
